title: Creative Technology Launches Sound Blaster, Setting the PC Audio Standard
reason: All material details confirmed by multiple independent sources: Singapore's Creative Technology (founded by Sim Wong Hoo) launched the Sound Blaster sound card at Comdex in Las Vegas on 16 November 1989; sold 600 units over the five-day show (one order roughly every four minutes, with 20-person queues at three cashiers in their booth); the card was built around a Yamaha OPL2 (YM3812) FM synthesizer chip; and by 1995 Sound Blaster had sold over 15 million units worldwide, capturing seven of every ten sound card sales. Wikipedia independently confirms the OPL2 chip and the exact 1995 figure (15 million units, seven of ten sales) verbatim. Creative's own 30-year retrospective and Custom PC's detailed history piece corroborate the Comdex date/location and sales-rush anecdote. No material detail in the description is contradicted by any source found.
